title: BNP Paribas Asia Pacific Campus
description: We at BNP Paribas believe the strongest investment any institution can make is in its people. The BNP Paribas Asia Pacific Campus is a demonstration of the Group’s growth and people strategy in the region. Located in Singapore at the heart of some of the most vibrant economies in the world, the Campus is our central hub for training and development in Asia Pacific. A stone’s throw away from the airport, on a 14,000 square meter property, the Campus consists of 2 conservation buildings. Restored with the support of the Singapore Government, it now boasts a modern infrastructure and state-of-the-art technology.

Although the narration uses the word "investment," it refers to developing the institution's people rather than requesting payment or offering financial participation to viewers. The described material therefore has an institutional promotional or informational context.
